quotes.text: Paying bills is stressful. That's why I stack them like plates on the bar.
When I miss a call I feel ignored. So I bench my phone to hear the ring.
A good night’s sleep recharges me. I nap on the squat rack for extra recovery.
I need more confidence at work. I lift my inbox like a barbell to feel the burn.
My relationship feels shaky. I ask my partner to spot my heart during every hug.
Bills keep piling up. I load them on the squat rack and treat them as a heavy set.
I hate traffic jams. I treat the stoplights as rest intervals for my calves.
My boss keeps moving the deadline. I add extra plates to my schedule and lift the date.
When I feel lonely, I invite my dumbbells for dinner. They bring the protein and the conversation.
